title: The Insane Story Behind America's Fastest Corvette
description:
In October twenty twenty-four, the president of General Motors strapped into a Corvette ZR1 on a banked oval in northern Germany and held it at two hundred thirty-three miles per hour. Chevrolet called it the fastest car an American automaker has ever built. But the Corvette has chased speed records for more than thirty-five years, and one of the fastest Corvettes ever was not built by Chevrolet at all. This is the story behind America's fastest Corvette. The story runs through a cancelled plan, a British engine, a boat-engine factory in Oklahoma, a rival in Connecticut, a fan with a three point seven million dollar cheque, and a new rival in the form of the Ford Mustang. We will tell it in order, label what is claim and what is measurement, and say where our sources disagree.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

15:00 The other numbers behind the speed

21:51 What the story tells us
